newsitem.title: USA: Lufthansa Cargo not to lift ex-US rates.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo not to lift ex-US rates.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo said it has no immediate plans to raise ex-U.S. rates or apply a fuel surcharge to cover rising fuel costs.
Spokesman Mel Torre said the airline is looking at the fuel issue carefully, but foresees no increase in ex-U.S. market rates before the end of the year.
That does not preclude a surcharge, but any fuel surcharge would be weighed against the likely response from other carriers, he said.
Lufthansa also would have to provide sufficient advance notice of any increase, he added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
